stem.text: Find the interval of convergence of the power series \( \sum_{n=2}^{\infty} \frac{2 (-1)^{n} \left(x - 4\right)^{n}}{5^{n} n^{2}} \). Use the ratio test for the interior and justify the behaviour at each endpoint.

answer_key.label: The interval of convergence is \( -1 \le x \le 9 \).

worked_solution.text: For the ratio test, form \( \left|\frac{\frac{2 (-1)^{n+1} \left(x - 4\right)^{n+1}}{5^{n+1} (n+1)^{2}}}{\frac{2 (-1)^{n} \left(x - 4\right)^{n}}{5^{n} n^{2}}}\right| \).
The series converges when \( \frac{\left|x - 4\right|}{5} < 1 \), that is \( \left|x - 4\right| < 5 \), so \( -1 < x < 9 \).

At \( x = 9 \) the series is \( \sum_{n=2}^{\infty} \frac{2 (-1)^n}{n^{2}} \), which converges by the alternating series test, since its terms alternate and their sizes decrease to 0. At \( x = -1 \) the series is \( \sum_{n=2}^{\infty} \frac{2}{n^{2}} \), which converges by the p-series test, since it is a multiple of a p-series with \( p = 2 > 1 \).
The interval of convergence is \( -1 \le x \le 9 \).

options.label: The interval of convergence is \( -1 < x < 9 \).
